Module 03 · Amplified work

Accessible guide: amplified work

Make your judgment visible, use AI to prepare and compare, and finish with a Mini-SOP you have tested yourself.

PDF
12 · Moments
SHA-256
08b057fd1826…

Official masterclass PDF

The official PDF is untagged and contains text embedded in images. Use this accessible HTML guide to follow its 12 moments.
Open PDF Download PDF
MasterclassWorkbookPlaybookPromptsAll resources
For your practice

Turn one real task into a way of working you can repeat.

When every delivery depends on memory and improvisation, you repeat decisions, carry friction, and cannot tell what AI improved.

What you will gain

You will leave with a clear personal workflow, a test log, and a version you can reuse without losing control.

How to proceed

Choose a task, observe your practice, compare sources, co-create the Mini-SOP, and test one case under human review.

What to verify

A Mini-SOP with input, steps, criteria, human review, output, exceptions, and a real-case test log.

Design my workflow

Repeat the workflow on a second case and change only what the log supports.

Amplified work

Amplification is not adding AI everywhere: improve one task without losing judgment or accountability.

Key points

  • Keep a manual path.
